notes.geometry: scatterometry lambda=532 nm, theta_i = [0.0, 85.0]; coverage per angle f <= (1+sin(theta_i))/lambda; two-angle coverage to ~3753 mm-1 (geometric max 2/lambda = 3760 mm-1)
notes.weights: w_i = |H_i|^2 / N_i, N_i = 5th percentile of positive PSD values
notes.error_metric: mean |log10(PSD_est/PSD_true)| over radial bins in band
notes.caveat: the simulated scatterometry channel uses the same Rayleigh-Rice linear forward model for measurement and inversion, so its sub-0.05-decade errors are model-internal bounds on calibration-limited accuracy, not real instrument performance
